name: Pomelo Coffee Roasters
industry: Specialty coffee roaster / food and drink e-commerce
site_type: WooCommerce shop: colour-blocked home page with real product cards, shop, product pages, cart drawer and a working demo checkout
features: real WooCommerce shop: four products with photos, prices and tasting notes, shop page, product pages, cart, checkout and account
checkout works end to end with a demo payment that takes no money; every order lands in WooCommerce > Orders
one flat shipping rate, US dollars, guest checkout, no setup wizard or coming-soon page on a fresh install
home page coffee cards read the real products: add to cart in the background, a small bag arcs into the header cart and WooCommerce's cart drawer opens
one colour per origin: each product has a "Card colour" setting used behind its photo
hero with three bags and tasting-note tags that drop onto each bag on drawn lines
tasting-notes ticker that drifts sideways and stops under the pointer
subscription band: a line-drawn coffee bean walks a loop and drops a bag each lap; 2 or 4 week buttons change the pace
brew-method tiles: each line-drawn brewer fills with coffee as it comes into view
demo-only newsletter field: nothing is sent and it says so
WooCommerce mini-cart and account icons in the header
six small custom blocks in a plugin, everything else native blocks; tags, notes and tiles edited in block sidebars
self-hosted fonts (Fraunces, DM Sans), no third-party scripts
reduced motion shows the finished states; without JavaScript every block shows its finished state
block theme, native blocks, block patterns, no page builder
